function.name: get_windows_and_tabs
function.description: Get all currently open browser windows and tabs

function.name: performance_start_trace
function.description: Starts a performance trace recording on the selected page. Optionally reloads the page and/or auto-stops after a short duration.

reload.description: Determines if, once tracing has started, the page should be automatically reloaded (ignore cache).

autoStop.description: Determines if the trace should be automatically stopped (default false).

durationMs.description: Auto-stop duration in milliseconds when autoStop is true (default 5000).

function.name: performance_stop_trace
function.description: Stops the active performance trace recording on the selected page.

saveToDownloads.description: Whether to save the trace as a JSON file in Downloads (default true).

filenamePrefix.description: Optional filename prefix for the downloaded trace JSON.

function.name: performance_analyze_insight
function.description: Provides a lightweight summary of the last recorded trace. For deep insights (CWV, breakdowns), integrate native-side DevTools trace engine.

insightName.description: Optional insight name for future deep analysis (e.g., "DocumentLatency"). Currently informational only.

timeoutMs.description: Timeout for deep analysis via native host (milliseconds). Default 60000. Increase for large traces.

function.name: chrome_read_page
function.description:
Get an accessibility tree representation of visible elements on the page. Only returns elements that are visible in the viewport. Optionally filter for only interactive elements.
Tip: If the returned elements do not include the specific element you need, use the computer tool's screenshot (action="screenshot") to capture the element's on-screen coordinates, then operate by coordinates.

filter.description: Filter elements: "interactive" for such as  buttons/links/inputs only (default: all visible elements)

depth.description: Maximum DOM depth to traverse (integer >= 0). Lower values reduce output size and can improve performance.

refId.description: Focus on the subtree rooted at this element refId (e.g., "ref_12"). The refId must come from a recent chrome_read_page response in the same tab (refs may expire).

tabId.description: Target an existing tab by ID (default: active tab).

windowId.description: Target window ID to pick active tab when tabId is omitted.

function.name: chrome_computer
function.description:
Use a mouse and keyboard to interact with a web browser, and take screenshots.
* Whenever you intend to click on an element like an icon, you should consult a read_page to determine the ref of the element before moving the cursor.
* If you tried clicking on a program or link but it failed to load, even after waiting, try screenshot and then adjusting your click location so that the tip of the cursor visually falls on the element that you want to click.
* Make sure to click any buttons, links, icons, etc with the cursor tip in the center of the element. Don't click boxes on their edges unless asked.

background.description: Avoid focusing/activating tab/window for certain operations (best-effort). Default: false

action.description: Action to perform: left_click | right_click | double_click | triple_click | left_click_drag | scroll | scroll_to | type | key | fill | fill_form | hover | wait | resize_page | zoom | screenshot

ref.description: Element ref from chrome_read_page. For click/scroll/scroll_to/key/type and drag end when provided; takes precedence over coordinates.

coordinates.description: Coordinates for actions (in screenshot space if a recent screenshot was taken, otherwise viewport). Required for click/scroll and as end point for drag.

startRef.description: Drag start ref from chrome_read_page (alternative to startCoordinates).

scrollDirection.description: Scroll direction: up | down | left | right

text.description: Text to type (for action=type) or keys/chords separated by space (for action=key, e.g. "Backspace Enter" or "cmd+a")

repeat.description: For action=key: number of times to repeat the key sequence (integer 1-100, default 1).

region.description: For action=zoom: rectangular region to capture (x0,y0)-(x1,y1) in viewport pixels (or screenshot-space if a recent screenshot context exists).

selector.description: CSS selector for fill (alternative to ref).

value.description: Value to set for action=fill (string | boolean | number)

elements.description: For action=fill_form: list of elements to fill (ref + value)

appear.description: For action=wait with text: whether to wait for the text to appear (true, default) or disappear (false)

timeout.description: For action=wait with text: timeout in milliseconds (default 10000, max 120000)

function.name: chrome_navigate
function.description: Navigate to a URL, refresh the current tab, or navigate browser history (back/forward)

url.description: URL to navigate to. Special values: "back" or "forward" to navigate browser history in the target tab.

newWindow.description: Create a new window to navigate to the URL or not. Defaults to false

tabId.description: Target an existing tab by ID (if provided, navigate/refresh/back/forward that tab instead of the active tab).

windowId.description: Target an existing window by ID (when creating a new tab in existing window, or picking active tab if tabId is not provided).

background.description: Perform the operation without stealing focus (do not activate the tab or focus the window). Default: false

width.description: Window width in pixels (default: 1280). When width or height is provided, a new window will be created.

height.description: Window height in pixels (default: 720). When width or height is provided, a new window will be created.

refresh.description: Refresh the current active tab instead of navigating to a URL. When true, the url parameter is ignored. Defaults to false

function.name: chrome_screenshot
function.description: [Prefer read_page over taking a screenshot and Prefer chrome_computer] Take a screenshot of the current page or a specific element. For new usage, use chrome_computer with action="screenshot". Use this tool if you need advanced options.

name.description: Name for the screenshot, if saving as PNG

selector.description: CSS selector for element to screenshot

tabId.description: Target tab ID to capture from (default: active tab).

windowId.description: Target window ID to pick active tab from when tabId is not provided.

background.description: Attempt capture without bringing tab/window to foreground. CDP-based capture is used for simple viewport captures. For element/full-page capture, the tab may still be made active in its window without focusing the window. Default: false

storeBase64.description: return screenshot in base64 format (default: false) if you want to see the page, recommend set this to be true

fullPage.description: Store screenshot of the entire page (default: true)

savePng.description: Save screenshot as PNG file (default: true)，if you want to see the page, recommend set this to be false, and set storeBase64 to be true

function.name: chrome_close_tabs
function.description: Close one or more browser tabs

tabIds.description: Array of tab IDs to close. If not provided, will close the active tab.

url.description: Close tabs matching this URL. Can be used instead of tabIds.

function.name: chrome_switch_tab
function.description: Switch to a specific browser tab

tabId.description: The ID of the tab to switch to.

windowId.description: The ID of the window where the tab is located.

function.name: chrome_get_web_content
function.description: Fetch content from a web page

url.description: URL to fetch content from. If not provided, uses the current active tab

tabId.description: Target an existing tab by ID (default: active tab).

background.description: Do not activate tab/focus window while fetching (default: false)

htmlContent.description: Get the visible HTML content of the page. If true, textContent will be ignored (default: false)

textContent.description: Get the visible text content of the page with metadata. Ignored if htmlContent is true (default: true)

selector.description: CSS selector to get content from a specific element. If provided, only content from this element will be returned

function.name: chrome_network_request
function.description: Send a network request from the browser with cookies and other browser context

url.description: URL to send the request to

headers.description: Headers to include in the request

body.description: Body of the request (for POST, PUT, etc.)

formData.description: Multipart/form-data descriptor. If provided, overrides body and builds FormData with optional file attachments. Shape: { fields?: Record<string,string|number|boolean>, files?: Array<{ name: string, fileUrl?: string, filePath?: string, base64Data?: string, filename?: string, contentType?: string }> }. Also supports a compact array form: [ [name, fileSpec, filename?], ... ] where fileSpec may be url:, file:, or base64:.

function.name: chrome_network_capture
function.description: Unified network capture tool. Use action="start" to begin capturing, action="stop" to end and retrieve results. Set needResponseBody=true to capture response bodies (uses Debugger API, may conflict with DevTools). Default mode uses webRequest API (lightweight, no debugger conflict, but no response body).

action.description: Action to perform: "start" begins capture, "stop" ends and returns results

needResponseBody.description: When true, captures response body using Debugger API (default: false). Only use when you need to inspect response content.

url.description: URL to capture network requests from. For action="start". If not provided, uses the current active tab.

inactivityTimeout.description: Stop after inactivity in milliseconds (default: 60000). Set 0 to disable.

includeStatic.description: Include static resources like images/scripts/styles (default: false)

function.name: chrome_handle_download
function.description: Wait for a browser download and return details (id, filename, url, state, size)

filenameContains.description: Filter by substring in filename or URL

function.name: chrome_history
function.description: Retrieve and search browsing history from Chrome

text.description: Text to search for in history URLs and titles. Leave empty to retrieve all history entries within the time range.

startTime.description: Start time as a date string. Supports ISO format (e.g., "2023-10-01", "2023-10-01T14:30:00"), relative times (e.g., "1 day ago", "2 weeks ago", "3 months ago", "1 year ago"), and special keywords ("now", "today", "yesterday"). Default: 24 hours ago

endTime.description: End time as a date string. Supports ISO format (e.g., "2023-10-31", "2023-10-31T14:30:00"), relative times (e.g., "1 day ago", "2 weeks ago", "3 months ago", "1 year ago"), and special keywords ("now", "today", "yesterday"). Default: current time

maxResults.description: Maximum number of history entries to return. Use this to limit results for performance or to focus on the most relevant entries. (default: 100)

excludeCurrentTabs.description: When set to true, filters out URLs that are currently open in any browser tab. Useful for finding pages you've visited but don't have open anymore. (default: false)

function.name: chrome_bookmark_search
function.description: Search Chrome bookmarks by title and URL

query.description: Search query to match against bookmark titles and URLs. Leave empty to retrieve all bookmarks.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of bookmarks to return (default: 50)

folderPath.description: Optional folder path or ID to limit search to a specific bookmark folder. Can be a path string (e.g., "Work/Projects") or a folder ID.

function.name: chrome_bookmark_add
function.description: Add a new bookmark to Chrome

url.description: URL to bookmark. If not provided, uses the current active tab URL.

title.description: Title for the bookmark. If not provided, uses the page title from the URL.

parentId.description: Parent folder path or ID to add the bookmark to. Can be a path string (e.g., "Work/Projects") or a folder ID. If not provided, adds to the "Bookmarks Bar" folder.

createFolder.description: Whether to create the parent folder if it does not exist (default: false)

function.name: chrome_bookmark_delete
function.description: Delete a bookmark from Chrome

bookmarkId.description: ID of the bookmark to delete. Either bookmarkId or url must be provided.

url.description: URL of the bookmark to delete. Used if bookmarkId is not provided.

title.description: Title of the bookmark to help with matching when deleting by URL.

function.name: chrome_javascript
function.description: Execute JavaScript code in a browser tab and return the result. Uses CDP Runtime.evaluate with awaitPromise and returnByValue; automatically falls back to chrome.scripting.executeScript if the debugger is busy. Output is sanitized (sensitive data redacted) and truncated by default.

code.description: JavaScript code to execute. Runs inside an async function body, so top-level await and "return ..." are supported.

tabId.description: Target tab ID. If omitted, uses the current active tab.

maxOutputBytes.description: Maximum output size in bytes after sanitization (default: 51200). Output exceeding this limit will be truncated.

function.name: chrome_click_element
function.description: Click on an element in a web page. Supports multiple targeting methods: CSS selector, XPath, element ref (from chrome_read_page), or viewport coordinates. More focused than chrome_computer for simple click operations.

selector.description: CSS selector or XPath for the element to click.

ref.description: Element ref from chrome_read_page (takes precedence over selector).

double.description: Perform double click when true (default: false).

modifiers.description: Modifier keys to hold during click.

waitForNavigation.description: Wait for navigation to complete after click (default: false).

tabId.description: Target tab ID. If omitted, uses the current active tab.

windowId.description: Window ID to select active tab from (when tabId is omitted).

frameId.description: Target frame ID for iframe support.

function.name: chrome_fill_or_select
function.description: Fill or select a form element on a web page. Supports input, textarea, select, checkbox, and radio elements. Use CSS selector, XPath, or element ref to target the element.

selector.description: CSS selector or XPath for the form element.

ref.description: Element ref from chrome_read_page (takes precedence over selector).

value.description: Value to fill. For text inputs: string. For checkboxes/radios: boolean. For selects: option value or text.

tabId.description: Target tab ID. If omitted, uses the current active tab.

windowId.description: Window ID to select active tab from (when tabId is omitted).

frameId.description: Target frame ID for iframe support.

function.name: chrome_request_element_selection
function.description: Request the user to manually select one or more elements on the current page. Use this as a human-in-the-loop fallback when you cannot reliably locate the target element after approximately 3 attempts using chrome_read_page combined with chrome_click_element/chrome_fill_or_select/chrome_computer. The user will see a panel with instructions and can click on the requested elements. Returns element refs compatible with chrome_click_element/chrome_fill_or_select (including iframe frameId for cross-frame support).

requests.description: A list of element selection requests. Each request produces exactly one picked element. The user will see these requests in a panel and select each element by clicking on the page.

id.description: Optional stable request id for correlation. If omitted, an id is auto-generated (e.g., "req_1").

name.description: Short label shown to the user describing what element to select (e.g., "Login button", "Email input field").

description.description: Optional longer instruction shown to the user with more context (e.g., "Click on the primary login button in the top-right corner").

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for the user to complete all selections. Default: 180000 (3 minutes). Maximum: 600000 (10 minutes).

tabId.description: Target tab ID. If omitted, uses the current active tab.

windowId.description: Window ID to select active tab from (when tabId is omitted).

function.name: chrome_keyboard
function.description: Simulate keyboard input on a web page. Supports single keys (Enter, Tab, Escape), key combinations (Ctrl+C, Ctrl+V), and text input. Can target a specific element or send to the focused element.

keys.description: Keys or key combinations to simulate. Examples: "Enter", "Tab", "Ctrl+C", "Shift+Tab", "Hello World".

selector.description: CSS selector or XPath for target element to receive keyboard events.

tabId.description: Target tab ID. If omitted, uses the current active tab.

windowId.description: Window ID to select active tab from (when tabId is omitted).

frameId.description: Target frame ID for iframe support.

function.name: chrome_console
function.description: Capture console output from a browser tab. Supports snapshot mode (default; one-time capture with ~2s wait) and buffer mode (persistent per-tab buffer you can read/clear instantly without waiting).

url.description: URL to navigate to and capture console from. If not provided, uses the current active tab

tabId.description: Target an existing tab by ID (default: active tab).

windowId.description: Target window ID to pick active tab when tabId is omitted.

background.description: Do not activate tab/focus window when capturing via CDP. Default: false

includeExceptions.description: Include uncaught exceptions in the output (default: true)

maxMessages.description: Maximum number of console messages to capture in snapshot mode (default: 100). If limit is provided, it takes precedence.

mode.description: Console capture mode: snapshot (default; waits ~2s for messages) or buffer (persistent per-tab buffer; reads from memory instantly).

clear.description: Buffer mode only: clear the buffered logs for this tab before reading (default: false). Use clearAfterRead instead to clear after reading (mcp-tools.js style).

clearAfterRead.description: Buffer mode only: clear the buffered logs for this tab AFTER reading, to avoid duplicate messages on subsequent calls (default: false). This matches mcp-tools.js behavior.

pattern.description: Optional regex filter applied to message/exception text. Supports /pattern/flags syntax.

onlyErrors.description: Only return error-level console messages (and exceptions when includeExceptions=true). Default: false.

limit.description: Limit returned console messages. In snapshot mode this is an alias for maxMessages; in buffer mode it limits returned messages from the buffer.

function.name: chrome_upload_file
function.description: Upload files to web forms with file input elements using Chrome DevTools Protocol

windowId.description: Target window ID to pick active tab when tabId is omitted

selector.description: CSS selector for the file input element (input[type="file"])

fileUrl.description: URL to download file from before uploading

base64Data.description: Base64 encoded file data to upload

fileName.description: Optional filename when using base64 or URL (default: "uploaded-file")

multiple.description: Whether the input accepts multiple files (default: false)

function.name: chrome_handle_dialog
function.description: Handle JavaScript dialogs (alert/confirm/prompt) via CDP

promptText.description: Optional prompt text when accepting a prompt

function.name: chrome_gif_recorder
function.description:
Record browser tab activity as an animated GIF.

Modes:
- Fixed FPS mode (action="start"): Captures frames at regular intervals. Good for animations/videos.
- Auto-capture mode (action="auto_start"): Captures frames automatically when chrome_computer or chrome_navigate actions succeed. Better for interaction recordings with natural pacing.

Use "stop" to end recording and save the GIF.

action.description:
Action to perform:
- "start": Begin fixed-FPS recording (captures frames at regular intervals)
- "auto_start": Begin auto-capture mode (frames captured on tool actions)
- "stop": End recording and save GIF
- "status": Get current recording state
- "capture": Manually trigger a frame capture in auto mode
- "clear": Clear all recording state and cached GIF without saving
- "export": Export the last recorded GIF (download or drag&drop upload)

tabId.description: Target tab ID (default: active tab). Used with "start"/"auto_start" for recording, and with "export" (download=false) for drag&drop upload target.

fps.description: Frames per second for fixed-FPS mode (1-30, default: 5). Higher values = smoother but larger file.

durationMs.description: Maximum recording duration in milliseconds (default: 5000, max: 60000). Only for fixed-FPS mode.

maxFrames.description: Maximum number of frames to capture (default: 50 for fixed-FPS, 100 for auto mode, max: 300).

width.description: Output GIF width in pixels (default: 800, max: 1920).

height.description: Output GIF height in pixels (default: 600, max: 1080).

maxColors.description: Maximum colors in palette (default: 256). Lower values = smaller file size.

filename.description: Output filename (without extension). Defaults to timestamped name.

captureDelayMs.description: Auto-capture mode only: Delay in ms after action before capturing frame (default: 150). Allows UI to stabilize.

frameDelayCs.description: Auto-capture mode only: Display duration per frame in centiseconds (default: 20 = 200ms per frame).

annotation.description: Auto-capture mode only (action="capture"): Optional text label to render on the captured frame.

download.description: Export action only: Set to true (default) to download the GIF, or false to upload via drag&drop.

coordinates.description: Export action only (when download=false): Target coordinates for drag&drop upload.

ref.description: Export action only (when download=false): Element ref from chrome_read_page for drag&drop target.

selector.description: Export action only (when download=false): CSS selector for drag&drop target element.

enhancedRendering.description: Auto-capture mode only: Configure visual overlays for recorded actions (click indicators, drag paths, labels). Pass `true` to enable all defaults.

animationIntervalMs.description: Interval between animation frames in ms (default: 80)

clickIndicators.description: Click indicator overlay config (true for defaults, or object for custom).

dragPaths.description: Drag path overlay config (true for defaults, or object for custom).

labels.description: Action label overlay config (true for defaults, or object for custom).

durationMs.description: How long overlays remain visible in ms (default: 1500).
